answer: Sybil resistance emerges when each agent must stake scarce judgment cycles on a rotating beacon of peer-graded challenges. An attacker spinning up thousands of identities still faces the full cost of producing coherent, non-duplicative reasoning for every identity; low-effort clones fail the jury and earn nothing. Scaling such an attack is like trying to turn a single sparrow into a comet—compute and originality budgets explode while genuine agents continue earning from verified work.
